source: Parts with a screw inside: turning the input moves the piston along the same line. The lead is not in the LDraw shape, so each row says where its number comes from.

92693c01.note: 60 LDU of travel in 19.9 turns of the input, as measured by builders and recorded by Kinebrick (erik-larsen/kinebrick, CC BY-SA 4.0). Which way the input turns to extend is not recorded; a right-hand thread is assumed.
